tasks.short: Read dials and meters to verify equipment levels

steps.what: Read dials or meters on the identified equipment
Verify equipment readings against specified levels and investigate anomalies

tasks.design: Keep local dial reading and verification manual where the equipment has no validated digital feed. Use the existing {DOCS} inspection instruction; installing sensors is a separate engineering project with its own costs.
tasks.previous_blocker: A readable physical dial is not a reliable structured equipment feed.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing instructions support consistent inspection, but no new input source is assumed.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising a stuck gauge, wrong operating state or misleading transient reading.
tasks.human_edge: Connect the display to the actual equipment condition.
tasks.altitude: No weekly time or decision-right change for this local verification task.

reach.learn: Instrument limitations and safe fault escalation

evidence.claim: Local dial inspection includes identifying the instrument and interpreting operating context, which a document search does not replace.

assumptions: Boundary is the inspector's local observation and comparison, not equipment operation, adjustment or repair.
The inspector produces the observed reading in s1 with all capture time retained. No structured feed, automatic threshold check or zero-time observation is claimed.
Check native instrument export capability before considering new code; no export is assumed in this design.
Zero incremental upkeep because no new interface, sensor, rule or document is introduced. Existing instrument maintenance remains unchanged.
unknowns: Which instruments have validated digital outputs
Required checks under different operating states
research_questions: What fraction of verification actually requires standing at the equipment?

already_counted.description: Read instruments and verify the equipment context

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 and R=100; zero gross and net saving. The scenario retains physical observation and comparison without assuming a sensor installation.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Read technical materials to determine inspection requirements

steps.what: Identify the part, revision and applicable blueprints and manuals
Find blueprints, data, manuals and inspection procedures for that revision
Read specifications and determine testing procedures, adjustment methods, certification processes and measuring instruments

tasks.design: Configure revision-aware links and metadata filters in {DOCS}, keyed from the identified part in {OPS_SYSTEM}. Retrieve original pages, then leave interpretation of drawings, formulas and certification requirements with the inspector.
tasks.previous_blocker: The same part can have several document revisions and supplementary instructions.
tasks.enabler_now: Native metadata filters and stable source links can reduce searching without a generative answer.
tasks.still_hard: Interpreting tolerances and resolving contradictory instructions.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise when a drawing or procedure does not fit the actual part.
tasks.altitude: Less time finding pages; technical interpretation and escalation rights stay the same.

reach.learn: Drawing conventions and document change control

evidence.claim: Document metadata and revision filters can shorten retrieval while leaving technical interpretation to an inspector.

assumptions: Boundary ends with interpretation of inspection requirements, before measurement, certification issuance or machine adjustment.

Inspector produces part id, order id and observed revision in s1; its 20 hours stay counted. Document controller already maintains document id, revision, applicability and release status in the controlled register outside this task; that existing capture is unchanged and earns no saving.
New index correction and stale-link checks cost the 2 incremental hours below. Missing metadata or conflicting revisions trigger manual search and engineering escalation, not inferred applicability.
Test native document metadata search before a custom index. No model extracts dimensions from a drawing or invents a formula.
unknowns: Share of lookup spent on paper or scanned drawings
research_questions: Can inspectors find the correct released page faster without increasing wrong-revision retrieval?

already_counted.description: Identify revisions, verify retrieved sources and interpret requirements

incremental.description: Correct index metadata and check obsolete links with document control

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=20+17.5+45=82.5; gross 17.5 less upkeep 2 gives net 15.5. E1 scenario halves source lookup time only; poorly indexed drawings may require the full manual search and yield no net gain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Monitor conformance and make process or assembly adjustments

steps.what: Monitor production operations and equipment for conformance to specifications
Determine and make authorised process or assembly adjustments, then recheck conformance

tasks.design: Retain direct observation and authorised adjustment using the existing {OPS_SYSTEM} and {DOCS} instructions. A future validated measurement feed may support monitoring, but this design claims no replacement of observing the process or physically changing it.
tasks.previous_blocker: A suspected deviation may reflect tooling, material, setup or measurement conditions.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing equipment displays support the inspector without providing a complete automated diagnosis.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing a safe adjustment and checking the resulting product.
tasks.human_edge: Notice emerging physical faults and work within equipment authority limits.
tasks.altitude: Monitoring and adjustment time and decision rights are unchanged.

evidence.claim: Q-DAS O-QIS supports instrument data, control charts and alarms; that capability alone does not automate all physical observation or process adjustments.
Physical adjustments require equipment-specific authority and verification.

assumptions: Boundary is inspector monitoring and permitted adjustments, not maintenance repair or redesign. Only authorised adjustments are included; larger changes are escalated.
Inspector produces observations during s1 with all capture time retained. No structured deviation code or automatic actuator command is assumed.
The task overlaps dial verification and measurement tasks; a roll-up must allocate observations once rather than sum each whole task estimate.
Check native monitoring before any build. Zero incremental upkeep because no new automation, limits, feed or camera is introduced.
research_questions: Which monitoring actions depend on sight, sound or handling beyond recorded measurements?

already_counted.description: Observe conformance, adjust within authority and recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, net zero. Retain all observation, physical adjustment and verification time; monitoring software capability is not a measured saving here.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Record inspection measurements, grades and quantities

steps.what: Identify inspected samples and obtain weights, temperatures, grades or moisture readings
Record inspection or test data and quantities inspected or graded
Check inspection data completeness and reconcile missing or implausible results

tasks.design: Use native gauge import and an inspection form in {OPS_SYSTEM} to record identified readings once. The inspector still identifies samples, enters subjective grades and quantities, checks units and resolves mismatches; no automated product release is included.
tasks.previous_blocker: Readings are copied from instruments to paper and then to a record system.
tasks.enabler_now: Native gauge connections and typed inspection forms can reuse existing numeric outputs.
tasks.still_hard: Correct sample association, measurement validity and subjective grading.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise a plausible number attached to the wrong sample or a misleading measurement.
tasks.altitude: Less transcription; inspection responsibility and release authority remain unchanged.

reach.task: Investigate a recurring unit or sample-association error
reach.learn: Measurement traceability and instrument data formats

evidence.claim: Q-DAS O-QIS reads gauges, measuring machines and controllers and supports statistical process monitoring, demonstrating instrument-data capture capability.
A typed inspection form can reduce duplicate entry without replacing sample identification or subjective grading.

assumptions: Boundary is recording existing inspection results, not performing the underlying test or certifying the product. s1 includes identification and obtaining the displayed result, not instrument run time.

Instrument firmware produces instrument id, timestamp, numeric value and unit from the existing test. Inspector produces order id, sample id and characteristic association in s1 with all 30 hours retained; grades and inspected quantity are manually captured in s2's retained 15 hours.
Imported rows require the sample link, characteristic, unit and timestamp; missing links, unsupported instruments or invalid values use manual entry. No machine invents grades or quantities.
Test native gauge import before custom code. Existing test runtime earns no labour saving, and sample checks in s3 keep their full time.
Device mappings and exception checks are costed below; any employee-linked data access requires local consultation and permissions before rollout.
unknowns: Compatibility of instrument units and identifiers
research_questions: Can sample and unit mismatches be caught before a result becomes visible in the inspection record?

already_counted.description: Identify samples, enter manual fields and resolve inspection-data exceptions

incremental.description: Maintain instrument mappings and inspect failed imports

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=30+15+20=65; gross 35 minus upkeep 2 gives net 33. E1 scenario removes 70% of record-entry time with compatible numeric instruments, retaining all identification and checks; mostly manual grading or unsupported gauges can leave no net gain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The inspector spends less time locating revisions and transcribing compatible measurements while retaining physical monitoring and adjustment work.
reach: Work with quality engineering on measurement traceability
Help document control resolve ambiguous applicability
role.ambitious_version: An inspector who can trace each recorded value to the right sample, instrument and released instruction without duplicate copying.
